I grow beans on this small plot because they help my soil and give us food to eat and sell at the market. Beans don't need chemical fertilizer like maize does, so I save whatever inputs I have for the maize plot, but I will put manure from our goats and chickens on this land before planting. I have kept seed from last season's harvest, which grows well here, and I don't have money for pesticides or hired workers when my family can manage the weeding and harvesting ourselves.
